newsitem.title: USA: Lear to buy ITT Industries seat systems business.
newsitem.headline: Lear to buy ITT Industries seat systems business.

text.p: ITT Automotive, a unit of ITT Industries Inc, said Monday it has entered into an agreement to sell its North American seat adjuster and recliner business to Lear Corp.
ITT Automotive's seat systems business in Europe is not part of the agreement, nor is certain seat track business for custom vans, the company said.
The business accounted for about $200 million in sales during 1996, ITT Automotive said.
Assets involved in the agreement include ITT Automotive plants in Walker, Roscommon and Elsie, Michigan, and St. Thomas, Ontario, Canada. The business unit employs about 1,000 people.
